stem.text: A particle is situated at rest between two metal plates X and Y.
A potential difference (p.d.) is then applied across the plates and produces the electric field shown.

stem.alt: Two vertical metal plates labelled X (left) and Y (right), with horizontal arrows drawn between them, a dot labelled particle between the plates, and a leader line labelled electric field.

stem.text: The particle moves towards plate X when the p.d. is applied.
